verdict.rationale: Per first-party docs, adding the "jules" label to a GitHub issue assigns the task to Jules directly (jules-docs-2), and the agent then produces a plan, diff and PR from it (jules-docs-4, jules-docs-8). The API is pitched for embedding Jules in tools like Linear and GitHub (jules-docs-16), and a community member mentions good GitHub integrations (jules-comm-2). missing for 10: detailed docs on how the issue content becomes task context, native integrations with non-GitHub trackers such as Linear or Jira (only possible via the custom API), and hands-on corroboration of the label-trigger workflow.
